0.a: Take a photo of your plant and our AI analyzes it for diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and pest damage within seconds.

1.a: All your farm data and diagnoses are stored locally on your device and optionally synced with your account.

2.a: AgroVision supports over 50 crop types including wheat, tomatoes, corn, olives, grapes, and many more.

3.a: Basic features work offline. AI diagnosis and weather data require an internet connection.

4.q: How accurate is the AI diagnosis?
4.a: Our AI model achieves over 90% accuracy on common plant diseases when a clear, well-lit photo is provided.
